author: Chen, C.H. and others
title: Search for the Rare Decay $B^+ \to \pi^+ e^+ e^-$
abstract: We report the results of a search for the rare decay $B^+ \to \pi^+ e^+ e^-$ in a sample of 657 million $B\bar{B}$ pairs collected at the $\Upsilon(4S)$ resonance with the Belle detector at the KEKB asymmetric-energy $e^+ e^-$ collider. We find no evidence for the decay and set an upper limit on the branching fraction.
